supported_scope: Native project configuration spans related folders, and file-write operations support edits within permitted paths. This supports multi-file work without adding an integration.
unestablished_scope: Guaranteed semantic consistency between implementation, configuration and tests
required_setup: Place the related folders in one project and select local or worktree mode for the conversation.
constraints: Non-Git folders remain local even when worktree mode is selected; this is not an isolation guarantee.
